text:
maya: Quick follow-up: proposing micro-shard (sub-blob) apply for onprem delta swaps to save bandwidth. Need to align on verifier contract, activation window, and KMS gating. Short summary: lower egress, higher apply complexity.

dan: Curious about operator failure modes  if a node partially applies and then loses power mid-activation?

maya: Right. Failure matrix I'm thinking: 
- power loss mid-write -> partial files in staging -> should be tombstoned by verifier on restart
- checksum validation fail for one shard -> tombstone that shard, operator chooses rollback or continue (if non-critical)
- missing dependency ordering -> apply out-of-order leads to runtime errors
Proposal: per-shard apply journal + per-activation commit marker and a manifest-level symlink swap to make activation atomic-ish.

srini: "Atomic-ish" is the right term. We can't do a true distributed transaction across GBs. Manifest symlink swap gives us fast activation and easy revert. Need signed manifest chain (signed per-release root) for verifier to validate inclusion without fetching full blobs.

tess: Ops UX: require a configurable "activation_window" where the new manifest is live but GC of old shards is paused. Operator can run smoke tests, then manual confirm or let it auto-close. Defaults: 5 minutes in prod. Add CLI command preview-manifest that shows per-shard diffs and estimated staging usage.

joel: +1 for preview-manifest and a GC dry-run. Also, expose emergency-revert that does an immediate symlink swap back and re-queues GC with high priority.

maya: Draft config snippet: 
```yaml
apply:
  strategy: micro-shard
  staging_dir: /var/redwood/stage
  commit_marker: .activate
  activation_window_seconds: 300  # hold old shards for 5m by default
  gc_policy: async_backoff
  rollback_policy: immediate_revert  # options: immediate_revert | staged_rollback
  kms_gate: required  # options: required | warn | optional
  fail_mode: strict  # options: strict | permissive
```

srini: KMS gating discussion: if KMS is unavailable during staging we shouldn't write commit_marker. Either fail the apply or require operator override. Pre-decrypting into staging is an option but increases exposure of plaintext on disk. Maybe allow pre-decrypt in isolated tmpfs with strict perms and scrub on failure.

dan: Agree operator override, with audit log (who allowed). Also surface a metric for partial-applies and alert when above threshold (say 0.1% of activations).

ops-bot: rollout: micro-shard strategy enabled on canary-pool-2 (10% nodes) for release/2026-03-19 :rocket:

maya: Verifier flow idea: publisher signs a release-root that contains merkle root over shard checksums. Nodes download shard manifest (signed) and validate inclusion. If shard checksum mismatches -> tombstone shard, report to ops with evidence. Node must refuse to write commit_marker unless all staged shards validate and KMS unwrap succeeded (if kms_gate==required).

tess: Edge-case: a node in low-disk situation can't stage all shards. We should implement a staged-fetch mode: fetch critical shards first, swap partial manifest that marks missing shards as pending and unlock a degraded mode. But we must be explicit about semantics to customers.

joel: For degraded mode, API should return 503 or feature-flagged fallback model (e.g., smaller quantized variant) rather than silent correctness loss. Documentable SLA.

maya: I'll sketch RFC follow-up with test matrix covering: complete apply, mid-verify checksum fail, power-loss during activation, KMS unavailable, low-disk staged-fetch path, rollback scenarios. Will include BDD scenarios and sample logs: 
```
[2026-03-19T09:11:02Z] apply: staging shard-12 -> ok
[2026-03-19T09:11:07Z] verifier: shard-12 checksum ok
[2026-03-19T09:11:10Z] KMS: unwrap ok
[2026-03-19T09:11:11Z] apply: wrote commit_marker .activate
[2026-03-19T09:11:12Z] operator: activation_window started (300s)
[2026-03-19T09:12:45Z] node: tombstoned shard-17 (checksum mismatch), operator notified
[2026-03-19T09:13:00Z] operator: immediate_revert -> swapped manifest -> activation complete
```

dan: Minor: add a histogram metric for activation_latency and a counter for revert_count.

srini: Security: ensure signed manifests have a revocation list or short TTL so keys can be rotated and bad releases removed quickly.

maya: Great notes. I'll write up the RFC follow-up and ping infra/security for signing/TTL constraints. Will add CLI preview, GC dry-run, and runbook for >threshold partial-applies. CC @srini @tess for verification/KMS sections. :thumbsup:

'tess: Let's also add a dev-mode permissive flag to allow fail-open for staging clusters with limited infra. Should be disabled in prod.

maya: Will include that. Thanks all.
